drhp.business: The Company grows and manufactures CTC and orthodox tea from its own estates (including Dooars, Darjeeling, Cachar and Terai) supplemented by bought leaf, selling domestically and exporting to more than 25 countries. Its fertiliser division, The Jay Shree Chemicals & Fertilisers at Khardah, West Bengal, manufactures Single Super Phosphate sold to farmers through a dealer and retailer network across West Bengal under the well-known "Annapurna" brand. The Company also operates a sugar mill in Bihar producing white sugar from crushed sugarcane, with a refinery and a distillery attached.

drhp.expansion: In the fertiliser business, a 400 TPD granulation plant is being commissioned at the Company's Single Super Phosphate operation to strengthen production capacity and market reach, and is expected to commence commercial production by August 2026.
